Fix = registered boundary: share ot_hbm_idx_vm_share_static_amr (request pin flops, vm_rr pin flops in the leaves, owner tap n+8, ARGMAX 4-edge chain -> 2-stage OR tree so ARGMAX port-to-port edges are UNCHANGED), TOPK command/result pin flops + engine RT_EXTRA 1 / ACK 13, ingest_v predicted from the root's own sel_op stream (SEL_LAT 4, selected_v checked -> fault), fault/share_fault pin flops. Latency: INDEX rq +1 / rr +1 (SW operand reader n+12), ARGMAX +0, TOPK go +1 / row +1 / writes +1 / done +1, fault +1, share_fault +1. Base r2: d4g argmax r2 binding (coordinator 0gl (3), lane HBM-IDXAM 10-18): ot_hbm_idx_rootctl_static with the share = ot_hbm_idx_vm_share_static_am (8:1 ARGMAX sector select + 4-edge equal-latency OR chain in the 4 bank-pair leaves): argmax face 2,056 b -> one 264-b word {lane valid8, data256} for ot_hbm_argmax_static_sw_vm_r2 (closed r3). One clock pin (the 8 IDX ctl clock nets were the same stream clock; tile < 0.5 mm), rst_n -> ot_rst_relay 3 regions. First hardening of idx_ctl (no view existed: GEN0/GEN1 bound SYNTH). Slot change for H-D4G-GEN2: 300x260 -> 475.2x259.2 (N index face 2,192 pins and S VM face 2,192 pins at 4.6/um; E argmax 400 + cq/cr 614 at 3.9/um; W control/TOPK 478).
